description: Dandies Staking Integration - Enable users to stake/unstake Dandies NFTs and claim rewards via the existing on-chain stake program

userStories.title: Copy stake IDL to solana-programs package
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the stake IDL in the correct location so Codama can generate the SDK.

userStories.title: Update generate.ts to include stake program
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the generate script to process the stake IDL.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated stake directory contains accounts/, instructions/, types/, and index.ts

userStories.title: Export stake SDK from solana-programs index
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to import the stake SDK from @biblio/solana-programs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'export * as stake from ./generated/stake' to packages/solana-programs/src/index.ts
Build succeeds with pnpm build in packages/solana-programs

userStories.title: Create stake service for fetching on-chain accounts
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service to fetch staker, collection, and emission accounts from the blockchain.
acceptanceCriteria: Use existing solana-client.ts for RPC connection

userStories.title: Add GET /api/stake/dandies endpoint
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to fetch Dandies staker info including collections and emissions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add GET /stake/dandies route returning { staker, collections, emissions }

userStories.title: Add GET /api/stake/records/:wallet endpoint
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to fetch a user's stake records to show their staked NFTs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add GET /stake/records/:wallet route returning { records: StakeRecord[] }

userStories.title: Add GET /api/stake/pending/:wallet endpoint
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to calculate and display pending rewards for a user.
acceptanceCriteria: Add GET /stake/pending/:wallet route returning { pending: { emission, amount }[] }

userStories.title: Create stake store with Jotai atoms
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need state management for staking data.
acceptanceCriteria: Add stakerAtom for cached staker account

userStories.title: Add fetch stake data action to store
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to fetch and populate staking data from the API.

userStories.title: Create use-staking hook with PDA helpers
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need helper functions to derive stake program PDAs.

userStories.title: Implement buildStakeCoreInstructions
userStories.description: As a user, I need to stake my Core NFTs (Dandies).
acceptanceCriteria: Add buildStakeCoreInstructions(nft, staker, collection) to use-staking hook
Include all required accounts (staker, collection, asset, nftAuthority, etc.)
Convert Codama instruction to web3.js TransactionInstruction

userStories.title: Implement buildUnstakeCoreInstructions
userStories.description: As a user, I need to unstake my Core NFTs (Dandies).
acceptanceCriteria: Add buildUnstakeCoreInstructions(nft, stakeRecord) to use-staking hook
Convert Codama instruction to web3.js TransactionInstruction

userStories.title: Implement buildClaimInstructions
userStories.description: As a user, I need to claim my staking rewards.
acceptanceCriteria: Add buildClaimInstructions(stakeRecord, emission) to use-staking hook
Include all required accounts including reward token accounts
Convert Codama instruction to web3.js TransactionInstruction

userStories.title: Add /stake route to App.tsx
userStories.description: As a user, I need to navigate to the stake page.
acceptanceCriteria: Create apps/web/src/routes/stake.tsx with basic StakePage component
Add Route path='/stake' element={<StakePage />} to App.tsx

userStories.title: Create StakeStats component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my staking statistics at a glance.

userStories.title: Create StakedNftsGrid component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my currently staked NFTs.
acceptanceCriteria: Display grid of staked NFT cards with images and names

userStories.title: Create AvailableToStakeGrid component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my unstaked Dandies that can be staked.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter user's NFTs to show only Dandies collection

userStories.title: Add StakeDialog confirmation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to confirm before staking an NFT.
acceptanceCriteria: Show NFT image and name in dialog
Close dialog and refresh data on success

userStories.title: Add UnstakeDialog confirmation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to confirm before unstaking an NFT.
acceptanceCriteria: Show NFT image and name in dialog
Show warning if minimum stake period not met
Close dialog and refresh data on success

userStories.title: Add ClaimRewardsButton and ClaimDialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want to claim my staking rewards.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Claim Rewards button to StakePage (disabled if no rewards)
Close dialog and refresh data on success

userStories.title: Add Staked badge to NFTs in main grid
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see which NFTs are staked when browsing my portfolio.
acceptanceCriteria: Check if NFT mint is in userStakeRecordsAtom
Badge styled to be clearly visible

userStories.title: Add staking link to sidebar navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want easy access to the staking page from the sidebar.
acceptanceCriteria: Use appropriate icon (e.g., LockClosed or similar)
